summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers drove Brent above $100 a barrel, pushing real yields higher and stressing bond duration. New Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies took effect July 24, adding trade friction that is weighing on tech and growth assets. Crypto remains the lone bright spot as risk appetite rotates to alternative assets.
tweet: Oil above $100 and fresh tariffs on 60 nations are doing the damage — bonds under pressure, tech soft, crypto the only asset holding a greed signal.
